lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p12 - Listen, point and say.

details: Listen, point and say checks understanding of word meaning and sound. Listen and point shows they match what they hear to the right image. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for careful listening, correct pointing, clear sounds, and confident repetition.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p12 - Read and circle.

details: Read and circle gives students an opportunity to review the target language and practice reading for understanding.
Look for clear pronunciation, and correct identification of each word while students read, and accurate circling of the appropriate words to complete the sentences.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p12 - 3. Try it out! Make a seasons poster.

details: Make a seasons poster provides further practice of the target language in a more engaging way, encouraging learner autonomy and collaboration skills if students are working in groups.
Look for student engagement, images to represent each season, correct labelling of the images and each student in the group contributing to the poster.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p60 - Answer and trace.

details: Answer and trace further reinforces the target language in a more personalised way. It reinforces whole-word memory, letter order, and neat handwriting.
Look for consistent letter formation, and neat handwriting within the lines, students only tracing one word and being able to accurately identify the word they have chosen.

Heads Down:

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p60 - Read and tick.

details: Read and tick reviews the key words and structures from the lesson. Students read the question and look at the pictures to choose which boxes to tick.
Look for accurate reading of the question, correct identification of all the pictures, and accurate ticking of the boxes for the clothes which match the season they chose in the previous exercise.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p12 - 4. Say the chant and do the actions.

details: Say the chant strengthens retention of the target language and helps improve pronunciation and stress. The TPR actions help strengthen recall of the target vocabulary.
Look for correct stress and confident participation, with most students able to join in with at least some of the actions and the most repeated parts of the chant.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p12 - 5. Make new verses for the chant.

details: Make new verses consolidates knowledge of the key structure and target language and gives students slightly less controlled practice of it.
Look for correct repetition of the parts of the chant that remain the same (the key structures) and the addition of the seasons and temperatures not previously used in the chant.
